[quote=arvek;61770946]Time and again TEP has targeted us, slandered us.

They say they wanted to forget about us, to compromise and move on peacefully.

But they have repeatedly struck at us, they have repeatedly mocked us.

They say they have no grudge against us and yet they would rather ban their own members for participating in our community than accept our existence.

They say they live in our heads rent free, but it is not us who keeps slandering them. It is not us who keep expressing a desire to raid them. It is not us who begs others to gather a 170 man strong raiding army.

Since the founding of our region they have ostracized us, mocked us, slandered us and now they have even devolved to an invasion.

Even a dog has its own pride, much less us. The time for peace is over, it is time that Cordone makes TEP suffer.

Our inaction has made them think we are helpless, but now it is time we made them bleed.

They must know that we desire peace, but that does not mean we will bow down and bend to their oppression.[/quote]
